intro: Ratings run from 40 to 99. Ten points is a small edge, not a different player: it shows over a season, not in one shift. Here is what ten points of each is worth.

effects.puckSecurity: how hard he is to check off the puck
effects.handleSpeedScale: how fast a puck he can take
effects.recoverScale: how fast he gets his wind back
effects.reactionSeconds: the time he takes to react
effects.lateralSpeed: how fast he moves across his crease
effects.coverRadius: how much of the net he covers
effects.freezeSpeed: how hard a shot he can hold on to
